cover: Rights monitor reports 14 killed in raids
Mother of man killed by police begins fast
Court acts on prisoner's missed cancer care

stories.label: Sudan's war
stories.figlab: killed in three days, monitor says
stories.head: Rights monitor reports 14 killed in raids
bullets: 12 died in East Darfur villages, 2 in West Kordofan.
The Sudan Human Rights Observatory blames RSF attacks.

stories.label: World · Life & safety
stories.place: South of El Hierro, Canary Islands
stories.head: Migrants found dead on boat off El Hierro
bullets: The boat left Gambia; about 90 people survived.
Al Jazeera reports at least 8 dead; RTVC at least 14.
Spain's minister cited the 'harshness of the Atlantic route'.

stories.label: India · Life & safety
stories.figlab: months since her son was killed
stories.head: Mother of man killed by police begins fast
bullets: Asha Devi's son died in a June police 'encounter'.
She began a fast-unto-death on 27 Nov.
Police say they fired in self-defence; a judicial inquiry was ordered.

stories.label: Accountability Watch
stories.figlab: jail requests for an escort, unanswered
stories.head: Court rebukes police over prisoner's cancer care
bullets: A prisoner with cancer missed his AIIMS follow-up.
The High Court said the police chief's conduct 'cannot be accepted'.
Two officers were suspended; the DGP ordered an inquiry.
